cards.front: Creí que tú lo sabrías puesto que eres su mejor amigo.
cards.back: I would have thought that you would know, seeing as you're her best friend.

cards.front: Pensaba que Jane estaría aquí puesto que es su fiesta de despedida.
cards.back: I would have thought that Jane would be here, seeing as it's her leaving do.

cards.front: Pensaba que vendría más gente porque es un bar con barra libre.
cards.back: I would have thought that more people would turn up, especially seeing as it's an open bar.

cards.front: No pensaba que nadie hubiera oído mucho del discurso con todo ese ruido de la sala de al lado.
cards.back: I wouldn't have thought anybody heard much of the speech with all that noise going on in the next room.

cards.front: No pensaba que él necesitaría a un profesional para decirle que estaba bebiendo demasiado.
cards.back: I wouldn't have thought he needed a professional to tell him that he's drinking too much.

cards.front: No creo que a nadie le importe si Sócrates era una figura histórica o no.
cards.back: I wouldn't have thought that anybody cared less whether Socrates was a historical figure or not.

cards.front: Nunca habría pensado que sus familias estarían de acuerdo con tal enlace.
cards.back: I'd never have thought that their families would agree to such a union.

cards.front: Nunca habría pensado que te sentirías obligado a apoyar un punto de vista tan controvertido.
cards.back: I'd never have thought that you would feel obliged to support such a controversial point of view.

cards.front: Nunca habría pensado que una humilde hija de molinero acabaría casándose con un príncipe.
cards.back: I'd never have thought that a lowly miller's daughter would end up marrying a prince.

cards.front: ¿Quién lo iba a decir? Una mujer primer ministro en uno de los países más machistas del mundo.
cards.back: Who'd have thought it? A woman prime minister in one of the most sexist countries on the planet.

cards.front: ¿Quién iba a decir que un ateo llegaría a ser tan popular en el Bible Belt?
cards.back: Who'd have thought that an atheist would become so popular in the Bible Belt?

cards.front: ¿Quién iba a decir que tanta gente se convencería con un argumento tan débil?
cards.back: Who'd have thought that so many people would be won over by such a weak argument?

cards.front: No me lo habría pensado dos veces si me hubieras pedido que donase dinero a esa ONG.
cards.back: I wouldn't have given it a second thought if you'd asked me to donate money to that particular charity.

cards.front: Si alguien me hubiera pedido ayuda para la causa, no me lo habría pensado dos veces.
cards.back: If someone had asked me to help with the cause, I wouldn't have given it a second thought.

cards.front: Si hubiera visto a un niño ahogándose en el río, no me lo habría pensado dos veces; lo habría rescatado.
cards.back: If I'd seen a drowning child in the river, I wouldn't have given it a second thought. I would have dived in to rescue it.

cards.front: Ahora que lo pienso, ninguno de los dos lo sabíamos por aquel entonces.
cards.back: Now that I think about it, neither of us knew that at the time.

cards.front: Ahora que lo pienso, ninguno de ellos quería tomar parte en el experimento al principio.
cards.back: Now that I think about it, neither of them wanted to take part in the experiment at first.

cards.front: Ahora que lo pienso, ninguno de ellos tenía ni idea de que llegarían a ser luchadores famosos.
cards.back: Now that I think about it, neither of them had any idea that they would become famous wrestlers one day.

cards.front: Ahora que lo pienso, ninguno de nosotros era consciente de lo que pasaba cuando empezamos la investigación.
cards.back: Come to think of it, none of us were aware of what was happening when we started the investigation.

cards.front: Ahora que lo pienso, ninguno de nosotros sabía lo peligrosa que era realmente la situación.
cards.back: Come to think of it, none of us knew how dangerous the situation really was.

cards.front: Ahora que lo pienso, ninguno de ellos estaba dispuesto a prescindir de su libertad para ser miembro del partido.
cards.back: Come to think of it, none of them were willing to give up their freedom to become party members.

cards.front: Pensándolo mejor, vosotros dos deberíais salir de la rueda de prensa ahora mismo.
cards.back: On second thoughts, both of you should leave the press conference right this minute.

cards.front: Pensándolo mejor, vosotros dos deberíais pedir perdón a Sophie personalmente.
cards.back: On second thoughts, both of you should apologize to Sophie personally.

cards.front: Pensándolo mejor, ellos dos deberían pagar las consecuencias.
cards.back: On second thoughts, both of them should pay the penalty.

cards.front: Pensando en voz alta, todos vosotros deberíais ver el documental. Os hará pensar.
cards.back: Thinking aloud, all of you should watch the documentary. It will make you think.

cards.front: Pensando en voz alta, todos nosotros deberíamos ir juntos de vacaciones. Sería tan divertido.
cards.back: Thinking aloud, all of us should go on holiday together. It would be such a laugh.

cards.front: Pensando en voz alta, todos ellos deberían poner dinero en el fondo común.
cards.back: Thinking aloud, all of them should put some money into the kitty.

cards.front: Y pensar que algunos de ellos se hacen llamar cristianos.
cards.back: And to think that some of them call themselves Christians!

cards.front: Y pensar que algunos de vosotros lleváis años estudiando inglés.
cards.back: And to think that some of you have been studying English for years.

cards.front: Y pensar que algunos de ellos ni siquiera sabían dónde se encuentra el país en el mapa.
cards.back: And to think that some of them didn't even know where the country was on the map.

cards.front: Pensé que este verbo sería lo suficientemente importante como para dedicarle un momento.
cards.back: I figured that this verb would be important enough to spend a moment looking at it.

cards.front: Pensamos que si no aprendes el verbo «to figure», tu inglés tendrá lagunas importantes.
cards.back: We figured that if you don't learn the verb "to figure", your English will be lacking an important element.

cards.front: Pensé que como mucha gente está obsesionada con su figura, un libro sobre dietas vendería más que un curso de inglés.
cards.back: I figured that as many people are obsessed with their figure, a diet book would sell more than an English course.

cards.front: Curiosamente, el personaje del hermano no aparece mucho en la novela.
cards.back: Strangely enough, the character of the brother doesn't figure much in the novel itself.

cards.front: ¿Por qué no apareces en los créditos?
cards.back: Why don't you figure in the credits?

cards.front: Trevor no destaca hasta la segunda mitad de la película.
cards.back: Trevor doesn't figure prominently until the second half of the movie.

cards.front: ¿No puedes resolverlo tú mismo?
cards.back: Can't you figure it out for yourself?

cards.front: Si no lo puedes resolver tú mismo, pide ayuda a tu profesor.
cards.back: If you can't figure it out for yourself, then ask your teacher to give you a hand.

cards.front: Puede que lleve un tiempo solucionarlo todo.
cards.back: It might take some time to figure it all out.

cards.front: No me explico que alguien como él pudiera hacer semejante cosa.
cards.back: It just doesn't figure that someone like him could do such a thing.

cards.front: No me explico que él pudiera haber ganado tanto dinero y luego gastarlo tan rápido.
cards.back: It just doesn't figure that he could have earned so much money and then spend it so quickly.

cards.front: No me explico que una persona religiosa pueda ser tan cruel con alguien desamparado.
cards.back: It just doesn't figure that a religious person could be so cruel to somebody who is so helpless.

cards.front: Por favor, no te ofendas: solo es una forma de hablar.
cards.back: Please don't be offended: it's just a figure of speech.

cards.front: Qué extraño: nunca he oído esa figura literaria antes.
cards.back: That's strange: I've never heard that figure of speech before.

cards.front: Qué figura literaria tan increíble acabamos de aprender.
cards.back: What an amazing figure of speech we've just learned!

cards.front: Creo que de ninguna manera lograremos terminar todo para esta noche.
cards.back: I reckon there's no way we'll get everything done by tonight.

cards.front: Yo creo que nunca vas a tirarte a la piscina.
cards.back: I reckon you're never going to take the plunge.

cards.front: Yo creo que está loco por pensar en hacer algo así.
cards.back: I reckon he's out of his mind to think about doing something like that.

cards.front: Yo creo que no hay otra opción.
cards.back: I believe there's no other option.

cards.front: Creo que el sistema entero necesita reformarse por completo.
cards.back: I believe the whole system needs a complete overhaul.

cards.front: Nosotros creemos que esta es la única vía para el progreso.
cards.back: We believe this is the only way forward.

cards.front: Quiero que todos reflexionéis sobre todo lo que se ha dicho hoy.
cards.back: I want you all to reflect upon everything that's been said today.

cards.front: ¿Has reflexionado sobre lo que hablamos la semana pasada?
cards.back: Have you reflected upon what we discussed last week?

cards.front: Hay mucho sobre lo que reflexionar.
cards.back: There's much to reflect upon.

cards.front: A menudo reflexiono sobre la naturaleza efímera de las cosas.
cards.back: I often muse upon the ephemeral nature of things.

cards.front: Vamos todos a reflexionar un rato sobre esa idea.
cards.back: Let us all muse upon that idea for a while.

cards.front: No es buena idea reflexionar sobre ese tipo de cosas.
cards.back: It's not a good idea to muse upon that sort of thing.

cards.front: Creo que los dos tenemos que reflexionar sobre si esta es la mejor línea de acción.
cards.back: I think we both need to ponder whether or not this is really the best course of action for us to take.

cards.front: Necesito cinco minutos para reflexionar sobre mis opciones.
cards.back: I need five minutes to ponder over my options.

cards.front: Creo que necesito reflexionar un rato sobre esto.
cards.back: I think I need to ponder over this for a while.

cards.front: Yo que tú, lo pensaría dos veces antes de comprar una casa en el mercado actual.
cards.back: If I were you, I'd think twice before buying a house in the current market.

cards.front: La próxima vez lo pensaré dos veces antes de prestarle dinero a alguien.
cards.back: The next time I'll think twice before I decide to lend someone any money.

cards.front: ¿Estás seguro de que es el hombre indicado? Deberías pensarlo dos veces antes de tomar una decisión final.
cards.back: Are you sure he's the right man for the job? You might want to think twice before making a final decision.

cards.front: No podemos reaccionar siempre a la competencia; tenemos que ser más previsores.
cards.back: We can't always react to what the competition or the market is doing; we need to think ahead more!

cards.front: Estoy empezando a pensar en mi jubilación y me asusta porque no he ahorrado ni un duro.
cards.back: I'm beginning to think ahead to my retirement and it's frightening as I'm starting to realize that I haven't saved a penny!

cards.front: ¿Por qué nunca piensas las cosas de antemano? No has traído ropa de abrigo para Londres en otoño.
cards.back: Why do you never think ahead?! I can't believe you didn't bring any warm clothes for a holiday in London in the middle of autumn!

cards.front: Iba a teñirme el pelo de rojo, pero después lo reconsideré.
cards.back: I was going to dye my hair red but then I thought better of it.

cards.front: Casi le dije que se metiera el trabajo por donde le cupiera; menos mal que cambié de opinión.
cards.back: I almost told him that he could stick his job; it's just as well that I thought better of it!

cards.front: Vámonos de la fiesta antes de que vuelvas a cambiar de opinión.
cards.back: Come on, let's leave the party now before you think better of it again.

cards.front: Tenemos que pensar muy bien en cómo vamos a contarles esto a los niños.
cards.back: We need to think long and hard about how we're going to tell the children about this.

cards.front: Me hace gracia que siempre piense tanto en las respuestas y después se suela equivocar.
cards.back: It makes me laugh that he always thinks so long and hard about the answers and then usually gets them wrong!

cards.front: Reflexionó durante mucho tiempo sobre dejar a su marido y después recapacitó.
cards.back: She thought long and hard about leaving her husband and then thought better of it.

cards.front: Nunca vamos a innovar de verdad a no ser que empecemos a pensar a lo grande.
cards.back: We're never going to truly innovate unless we start thinking big.

cards.front: ¿Sabes lo que tienen en común todos los directores generales legendarios? Pensaban a lo grande.
cards.back: Do you know what all the legendary CEOs have in common? They all thought big.

cards.front: Cuando dije que teníamos que pensar a lo grande, no me refería a tu cuerpo. Has engordado.
cards.back: When I said that we needed to think big I wasn't referring to your body! You've put on loads of weight!

cards.front: Él es de la vieja escuela, que cree que el lugar de la mujer está en la cocina.
cards.back: He comes from the old school of thought that believes a woman's place is in the kitchen.

cards.front: No creo en esa escuela de pensamiento económico keynesiano.
cards.back: I don't believe in that Keynesian economic school of thought.

cards.front: La gente que cree en el creacionismo es la misma que no cree en el calentamiento global.
cards.back: I think you'll find that the school of thought that believes in creationism is the same one that doesn't believe in global warming.

cards.front: Tus comentarios profundos nos darán sin duda algo en que pensar a todos.
cards.back: Your profound comments will certainly give us all food for thought.

cards.front: No quería que mis palabras se interpretasen como una orden; solo era algo para reflexionar.
cards.back: My words were not intended as an order; it was merely food for thought.

cards.front: Muchas gracias por tus ideas; nos han dado mucho en que pensar.
cards.back: Thanks for your ideas; they've given us lots of food for thought.

cards.front: Perdona, he perdido el hilo. ¿Qué estaba diciendo?
cards.back: I'm sorry, I've lost my train of thought. What was I saying?

cards.front: Tu interrupción me ha hecho perder el hilo; ahora no sé de qué hablaba.
cards.back: You've interrupted my train of thought; now I have no idea what I was talking about.

cards.front: Tu entrada repentina le hizo perder el hilo por completo.
cards.back: Your sudden entrance made her lose her train of thought completely.

cards.front: Lo siento, ¿me estabas hablando a mí? Estaba totalmente ensimismado.
cards.back: I'm sorry, were you talking to me? I was completely lost in thought.

cards.front: Creo que está estresado últimamente; siempre parece estar ensimismado.
cards.back: I think he must be quite stressed lately; he always seems to be lost in thought.

cards.front: No has oído ni una palabra porque estabas completamente ensimismada.
cards.back: Well of course you haven't heard a word I've said; you were completely lost in thought.

cards.front: Si algo le sucediera a mi ahijado, Dios no lo quiera, sabes que yo le cuidaría.
cards.back: If anything ever happened to my godson, perish the thought, you know that I would look after him.

cards.front: Dios nos libre de que alguna vez se les ocurra casarse.
cards.back: Perish the thought that they ever think about getting married.

cards.front: ¿Que si se ha levantado aún? Ni lo pienses. Aún no son ni las diez.
cards.back: Has he got up yet? Perish the thought! It's not even 10 o'clock yet.
